none: PAS LIN-017DD7: Roman nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine (AD 307-361), dating from AD 318-320 (Reece Period 16). Probably [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP] reverse type depicting two Victories holding wreath inscribed [VOT] / (P R). Unclear mint. Obverse description: Bust left, radiate crown. Obverse inscription: illegible. Reverse description: Two Victories holding a wreath inscribed VOT / P [R]. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP]. Mintmark: Illegible. Diameter: 15.48 mm; Thickness: 1.68 mm; Weight: 1.18g
